purpose: Frozen record of the R1-update model validated by chronological walk-forward on the full-field historical R1 warehouse (survivor-bias resolved). After this freeze: NO KB-driven changes to any coefficient, feature definition, or selection rule below.

training_corpus.excluded_reason: 3 player-events had a made_cut=true outcome with no finish_position on record -- excluded rather than guessed (never assigned a tier label from an assumption).

kb_holdout.note: KB never appears in either source corpus -- confirmed by direct membership check, not merely asserted.

NEO_HISTORICAL_TRUTH_WAREHOUSE_V1.json.role: PRE-time features (frozen_model.NEO_V1_score) + final outcome (made_cut, finish_position) per historical player-event.

NEO_HISTORICAL_R1_FULL_FIELD_V1.json.role: Full-field (CUT/WD/DQ-inclusive) round-1 raw scores, recovered on 2026-09-10 to replace the survivor-biased historical_sg_warehouse.json source -- see commit 9978ecf on feat/kb-r1-2026090003.

survivor_bias_resolution.identity_unresolved_disposition: These 1852 full-field R1 starters have no matching Truth Warehouse outcome record (that warehouse's own population is itself SG_ROW_RECONSTRUCTED and incomplete) -- excluded from training since no supervised label exists for them. every Truth Warehouse row DID find a full-field R1 match (0 missing joins on the label side).

pre_score.description: PRE-time NEO Ranking V1 composite strength score, already leakage-verified by that warehouse's own construction (validation.future_leakage=false on every row). Higher = better.
pre_score.not_reused_from: This is NOT pre_v2.py / NEO_PRE_5PROB_V2 (KB's live PRE model) -- a structurally different model family. See KB_2026090003_R1_KB_APPLICATION_BLOCKER_V1.json for why.

r1_z.formula: -(r1_to_par - field_mean) / field_stddev, computed per-tournament from that tournament's own full recovered R1 field only

feature_standardization.note: Fit on the FULL 82-tournament corpus for this freeze (walk-forward validation itself used train-fold-only standardization at each step -- see validation_metrics).

model_form: Nested conditional logistic chain -- P(made_cut), P(top20|made_cut), P(top10|top20), P(top5|top10), P(win|top5), each a 2-feature logistic regression (intercept + pre_score + r1_z), composed by multiplication. See src/klpga/neo_win/r1_model_v1.py module docstring for the exact equations and the coherence proof (0<=win<=top5<=top10<=top20<=cut<=1 by construction, never by clipping).
fitting_method: Gradient descent, 300 iterations, learning rate 0.5, fixed L2 ridge 1e-3 (a disclosed numerical-stability constant, never tuned to favor a result) -- deterministic given the training rows, no stochastic step anywhere in fitting.

candidate_selection.candidate_C_considered_not_selected: pre_score + r1_z + consistency -- walk-forward Brier improvement over B was <0.0006 on every tier (e.g. made_cut 0.14618 vs 0.14609), not a meaningful gain for the added complexity. Selection rule (fixed before this comparison): prefer the simplest candidate unless a more complex one improves tournament-level mean Brier by a non-trivial margin on a majority of tiers.

validation_metrics.method: Chronological walk-forward, threshold=10 (minimum 10 strictly-prior tournaments to be an eligible target), 72 eligible target tournaments out of 82, refit at every step from a fresh train-fold-only standardization -- no target-tournament or later-tournament row ever entered a training fold.
validation_metrics.rare_event_guard: WIN (67 positive rows / 72 tournaments) and TOP5 (392 positives) are the rare tiers this task's own rules flag for extra scrutiny. Both still show a 95% tournament-level paired bootstrap CI for the Brier improvement that excludes zero (WIN: [0.00024, 0.00067]) -- evidence judged sufficient to proceed, not WAIT/BLOCKED, but the margin is real and small and should not be overstated in any public-facing copy.

stability_by_period.note: eligible targets split into early/middle/late thirds (24 tournaments each); candidate B's mean Brier improvement over A stayed positive and of comparable magnitude in every period for every tier -- no degradation trend. Exact per-period numbers: made_cut [0.06562, 0.06303, 0.06560]; top20 [0.03043, 0.02372, 0.02596]; top10 [0.01829, 0.01477, 0.01298]; top5 [0.00709, 0.00797, 0.00525]; win [0.00049, 0.00053, 0.00033].

calibration.made_cut: 6 bins [0,0.1)..[0.9,1.0]: predicted vs actual pairs (0.045,0.041) (0.196,0.154) (0.402,0.380) (0.606,0.552) (0.810,0.797) (0.952,0.945) -- modest overconfidence in the 0.5-0.7 band (~5pp), acceptable elsewhere.

validation_metrics.coherence: 0 violations / 7018 predicted rows across both candidates in walk-forward -- guaranteed by the nested model form, not observed as an empirical coincidence.

publication_decision_detail: The model passes on its own terms: beats the PRE-unchanged baseline on all 5 tiers, statistically significant (bootstrap CI excludes zero) on all 5 tiers including the rare WIN/TOP5 tiers, stable across time, reasonably calibrated, structurally coherent, and selected via a rule fixed before any KB inspection. This freeze exists independently of whether the model can currently be APPLIED to KB -- see KB_2026090003_R1_KB_APPLICATION_BLOCKER_V1.json for that separate question.
